Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted; no casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
